status: Implementation specification; does not extend the repository provider automatically
clock: Existing plugin t, simulated seconds. Freeze time.speed per scheduled bank, or rebuild at a run boundary.
accept: collisionTime/speed >= 35, finite trajectory, no prior contact or escape, reference screen passes; minimum requirement is strictly >30 active seconds
pureAt: Binary search immutable sorted segments, sample immutable trajectory, return values in fixed names order. No integration, random selection, timers, or side effects in at(t).
determinism: Choose and store a shuffled case-ID order before playback. Finite bank may repeat a precomputed cycle; exact cycle boundary belongs to next orbit. Negative time clamps to first frame. Pause retains t.
naming: These are semantic keys, not Desmos identifiers. Allocate legal single-letter/subscript symbols and a stable index map.

flash.center: mass-weighted center at refined first contact
flash.thirdBody: freeze at contact and dim; hide colliding bodies
flash.field: fade or disable field overlay; do not continue a singular post-contact gravity solution

externalMetadata: trajectory sample times and xyz per body
interpolation policy shared by JS/native geometry
collision pair, refined contact time, center and radii
trailPolicy: Upload immutable sample lists once per run or bank. Expose scalar local time/index; display prefix/window ending at current interpolated position. Never join the last sample of one run to the first sample of another. Native trace geometry is separate from decorative GPU field-particle trails.
eventHandling: Plugin compares runId and phase outside at(t), clears obsolete particle trails, swaps owned trajectory lists once at a boundary, and applies visibility. Dropped frames crossing multiple segments resolve directly to the segment containing t.
